hypothesis: On a fresh frozen BIRD dev sample, a single repair restricted to the original retrieved V00 schema context improves Set EX over one-shot generation and is within 5 percentage points of a single repair that can see the full R0 database schema, without accepting identifiers outside V00.
prior_art_position: Exploratory local utility evaluation; generic validation, bounded repair, full/pruned schema comparison, and execution feedback are established method classes and are not claimed as novel.

dataset.name: BIRD dev
dataset.retrieval_source: P2c-R V00, fixed 1024-token selected node IDs and R0 texts

sample.selection_algorithm: See the registered protocol; private IDs and per-question labels remain local.

dataset.evidence_status: exploratory; BIRD dev has been repeatedly used and is not an independent test set

arms.A0: same one-shot E0/V00 generation; no repair
arms.A1: one repair attempt with full R0 schema; safe read-only compile/execute gate
arms.A2: one repair attempt with only original V00 context; SQLite authorizer blocks reads of unselected tables/columns

repair_policy.trigger: Only initial output that fails SQL parse or read-only SQLite schema/scope compilation

metrics.primary: Set Execution Accuracy on all 66 full-sample questions
secondary: post-repair executable rate among initial failures
input/output tokens and repair requests per arm

decision_gates.minimum_repair_signal: At least 10 initial parse/schema compile failures in Full; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_REPAIR_CASES and no sample expansion.
decision_gates.exploratory_success: A2 Set EX >= A0 + 5 percentage points; A2 Set EX >= A1 - 5 percentage points; zero A2 accepted out-of-context table/column reads; all input hashes and model usage accounting valid.
stop: SQL safety or immutable-database gate failure
Missing model request usage, request timeout, or transport failure
Output path collision or privacy leak
GPU, RAM, wall-clock, request, or token budget reached

local_artifacts.public_artifacts: protocol, runner, anonymized aggregate, complete experiment report
local_artifacts.private_artifacts: sample IDs, prompts, generated SQL, reference SQL, database rows, per-question execution results, raw service logs
